description: The configuration surface of the virtual-machine chart. GENERATED from values.yaml by `./build.sh Charts` and diffed in CI — docs/plan/03 § charts/. Edit values.yaml, never this file. Members carrying `x-cybercloud-api: false` are chart or platform plumbing and are not part of the resource body.

cloudInit.description: First-boot configuration, as cloud-init reads it.

userData.description: A vault handle — path#field, optionally @version — whose value is the cloud-init user data: the #cloud-config with your users, SSH keys and packages. Resolved when the machine is rendered and written into a Secret the machine mounts; the value never enters this body. Empty means no cloud-init at all.

dataDisks.description: CyberCloud.Compute/disks resources attached to the machine, by name, in this resource group. A change attaches or detaches at the machine's next start. ⚠ A disk named os or cloudinit collides with the machine's own volumes and is refused at admission.

image.description: The CyberCloud.Compute/images resource the root disk is cloned from, by name, in this resource group. ⚠ The image must have finished importing: the machine waits for it and says so.

nameOverride.description: Replace the generated object-name stem. Empty means derive it from the release name.
nameOverride.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Helm plumbing. Nothing about it belongs in a resource body.

network.description: The tenant network the machine's interface joins. Both empty means the cluster's pod network.

subnet.description: The subnet of that network the interface takes its address from, by name, or empty. ⚠ A name that is not a subnet of the network is refused by the fabric rather than by this API, and the machine never starts.

virtualNetwork.description: The CyberCloud.Network/virtualNetworks resource in this resource group, by name, or empty.

osDiskSize.description: The root disk, in Kubernetes quantity form. At least the image's own size; a clone into a smaller claim is refused by CDI, not by this API. ⚠ Immutable, for the reason a managed disk's size is.

platform.description: Resource identity injected by the reconciler. Not a tenant-facing setting.

apiVersion.description: The api-version the resource was last written at, rendered into the cybercloud.io/api-version label.
apiVersion.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

managedBy.description: Value of the cybercloud.io/managed-by label. Constant, and the selector every informer filters on.
managedBy.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

resourceGroup.description: Resource group name, rendered into the cybercloud.io/resource-group label.
resourceGroup.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

resourceId.description: Resource GUID, rendered into the cybercloud.io/resource-id label.
resourceId.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

resourceType.description: Fully qualified resource type, rendered into the cybercloud.io/resource-type label.
resourceType.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

subscriptionId.description: Subscription GUID, rendered into the cybercloud.io/subscription-id label.
subscriptionId.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

tenantId.description: Tenant GUID, rendered into the cybercloud.io/tenant-id label.
tenantId.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

platform.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

runStrategy.description: KubeVirt's run strategy — Always for a machine that should be on, Halted for one that should be off.
runStrategy.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: The power state. The reconciler reads it off the VirtualMachine object before every render and writes back what it found; the start and stop actions are what change it. A tenant has no body property for it, which is why it is not generated from the schema.

size.description: The machine's size, from the platform's sizing catalogue: s1.small is 1 vCPU and 4 GiB, and each rung doubles both. Changing it takes effect the next time the machine starts — KubeVirt reports RestartRequired until then.
